title: Concept: Dependency resolved from a local directory
description: composer.json declares a repository of type `path`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a repository of type `path`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a repository of type `path`.
